scaling_decision_history.description:
ScalingDecisionHistory retains only the newest approved recommendations in
this in-memory Flow. Dropped counts expose truncation; clear/delete/restart
remove this PoC history. It is not a durable research event journal.

trigger_decision_id.description:
TriggerDecisionID identifies the local scaling decision that produced an
optimized revision. The Common JSON decision_id remains the initial one.

action.description: Action is KEEP, SCALE_OUT, or SCALE_IN. Legacy NO_ACTION is accepted only in an Operation Agent proposal/result and is normalized to KEEP before Scaling Guard validation.

current_replicas.description: CurrentReplicas is the latest guarded plan's desired count, not an independently observed applied count.

decision_id.description: DecisionID is assigned locally after Guard approval; it is not an action ID.

receipt_received_at.description: ReceiptReceivedAt is set only after a matching AppDeployer response.

request_id.description: RequestID identifies the approved KHU request, not an AppDeployer action.

request_message_id.description: RequestMessageID is the approved KHU Common JSON message ID.

reserved_at.description: ReservedAt is before HTTP POST and does not prove AppDeployer received it.

status_observations.description: StatusObservations are source-declared states, not ready-replica evidence.

message.example: Malformed request body: check JSON syntax

effective_updated_at.description: EffectiveUpdatedAt is the time used by the in-memory Flow status.

fallback_reason.description: FallbackReason explains why the raw source time could not be used.

fetched_at.description: FetchedAt is the local KHU status fetch time.

source_updated_at.description: SourceUpdatedAt preserves the raw AppDeployer-declared status time.

status.description: Status is the AppDeployer-declared state, not a readiness measurement.

time_basis.description: TimeBasis identifies whether source time or local fetch time was used.
